title: 26 CFR 31.3102-4, Special rules regarding Additional Medicare Tax
issuer: Legal Information Institute, Cornell Law School (eCFR text)

passages.question: Does a married filing status change when Additional Medicare withholding starts?
passages.excerpt: An employer is required to collect from each of its employees the tax imposed by section 3101(b)(2) (Additional Medicare Tax) with respect to wages for employment performed for the employer by the employee only to the extent the employer pays wages to the employee in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year. This rule applies regardless of the employee's filing status or other income.
